messages:
sam: Midnite thought experiment: if you could pair one comfort anime with one utterly incongruent soundtrack for max emotional whiplash, what are you choosing? :thinking_face:
irene: Cowboy Bebop + twee indie folk. imagine Spike with a ukulele. horrifying and amazing.
zack: Nichijou + Vivaldi. slapstick backed by baroque strings. cinematic chaos. :laughing:
lina: Spirited Away + early 2000s R&B. dreamy bathhouse + smooth falsetto = chef's kiss.
eli: Kiki's Delivery Service + industrial techno. she learns to fly over a rave warehouse. 10/10 absurd.
sam: Vote emoji: 
  💙 = Bebop + folk
  🍺 = Nichijou + Vivaldi
  🌸 = Spirited Away + 2000s R&B
  🔥 = Kiki + techno
soundbot: auto-mix links: https://example.fake/mix1 (twee indie tweaks), https://example.fake/mix2 (baroque mash), https://example.fake/mix3 (R&B recontext), https://example.fake/mix4 (industrial set)
irene: 💙 from me. fragile Spike with soft harmonies is a crime scene i want to attend.
zack: 🍺. imagine dramatic Vivaldi sting when something ridiculous happens.
lina: 🌸. nostalgia + otherworldly softness.
eli: 🔥 for the absurdity. also GIF: tiny rave-laptop kitten.
sam: Tally: Bebop 1, Nichijou 1, Spirited 1, Kiki 1. tie. final tiebreaker: one single track you want on repeat during the pairing.
irene: "Autumn Leaves (acoustic)" 			for Bebop + folk.
zack: "Spring (Allegro) - Vivaldi" cut to 30s chaos clip.
lina: "U Got It Bad (slow cover)" as a lullaby for Spirited Away scenes.
eli: "Industrial Heartbeat (extended)" for Kiki's midnight courier montage.
sam: Plan: i'll run a 90-min rotated playlist tonight from 23:30 in the kitchen: each pairing gets a 20-min block. tiny snacks provided. bring your most ridiculous pairing idea and a mug. :coffee:
eli: i'll bring neon glowstick hat.
lina: i'll bring a paper lantern for ambience.
soundbot: kitchen event posted at 23:30 (auto-message).
